description: Election Commission - Declare that H. R. S. Weerasinghe as a member of the Colombo Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in the Colombo Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement by a recognized political party. This falls squarely under Election-related matters (announcements, candidate nominations, and declarations for local authority elections).
